schema_version.description: The packet identity this packet records. "1.0" is the released packet: it never carries inputs.worker_job. "1.1" is the job-capable packet (CD-0205): it may carry inputs.worker_job when the dispatcher selected a ready worker-job revision.

report_protocol.description: Dispatch-owned final-report framing, covered by the authorized packet digest. New builders pin this protocol; absence identifies historical legacy output. This is not report schema or worker identity.

context.description: Prose context a packet built before the typed record members carried. The lane-packet schema keeps it so a retained packet from an attempt dispatched before that change still validates on recovery. The core dispatch admission refuses it, so no new packet carries it.

law_context.description: The approved contract's binding law and Domains the pinned continuity resolved. The core refuses a dispatch whose packet member differs from the current recorded state, omits a present record, or carries a member no record backs.

design_record.description: The current typed design record (CD-0128). The core refuses a dispatch whose packet member differs from the current recorded state, omits a present record, or carries a member no record backs.

proposal_record.description: The recorded proposal's problem, user outcomes, and constraints. The core refuses a dispatch whose packet member differs from the current recorded state, omits a present record, or carries a member no record backs.

source_event_id.description: The durable failure, rejection, or correction-request event that opened this correction. The diagnosis and strategy are that event's directions. The core refuses a packet whose correction names a different source than the current correction.

work_context.description: CON-887: the current work-context view the work pin carried when the packet was built. The core refuses a dispatch whose packet does not consume the current view byte-for-byte, exactly as it refuses a packet that skips a durable correction.

checkpoint.description: CON-883: the latest context checkpoint the pinned continuity projection carried when the packet was built, with its durable identity. The core refuses a dispatch whose packet does not carry the latest checkpoint byte-for-byte; its strategy and diagnosis are coordinator directions to follow.

objective_source.description: Where inputs.task came from: contract_premise is the approved contract premise carried verbatim; work_question is the recorded work question carried before contract approval.

contract_version.description: The applicable contract version, or null when no contract applies.

assigned_result.description: The one evidence obligation whose discharge completes this attempt, derived from the registered lane.

predicate_id.description: The store refuses a predicate_id without the "predicate:" prefix. Write ids in the form "predicate:<name>".

lane_packet_worker_job.description: The selected ready worker-job revision this attempt executes (CD-0205). The core refuses a packet whose worker_job is not a ready recorded revision with this exact content, and refuses the member on a pinned definition that predates worker jobs. inputs.task stays the complete parent contract premise; this object bounds the attempt's own objective.

acceptance_oracle.description: The CON-890 owner-level acceptance oracle of the selected revision: the one oracle copy every admitted lane receives. Optional and omitted on every revision a pre-oracle definition recorded. The core refuses a packet whose worker_job differs from the recorded ready revision, oracle included.

lane_worker_oracle_mechanism.description: The source-level owner of one obligation (CON-890): the Project that owns the repository, one contained source path, and the symbol or entry point that owns the behavior.

path.description: A normalized relative repository-contained source path.

recipe_source.description: The exact pinned recipe manifest, not the candidate's modified harness. Native preparation resolves its file bytes, cwd, build-selected witnesses, and environment without test execution. Dispatch consumes that qualified preparation, never an automatic compiler or control run.

argv.description: The exact argument vector of the control, never shell text.

readiness_evidence_refs.description: The qualified native preparation run references for this exact owner/case/control bundle, parent contract, Project, raw subject, and environment. A legacy green command, unrelated evidence binding, compilation assertion, or zero-selector control is not readiness.

lane_worker_acceptance_oracle.description: The CON-890 owner-level acceptance oracle of one immutable worker-job revision, carried verbatim from the recorded job (CON-890). Every bound mirrors internal/store AcceptanceOracle exactly.

lane_worker_oracle_receipt.description: One typed control-execution receipt (CON-890), mirroring contracts/agent-lane-report.schema.json $defs/oracle_receipt exactly: reported evidence, never native-run authority. A retained receipt is a prior-subject regression baseline; subject_commit is the host-derived raw OID, filled only from the packet's core work context. A timeout is unavailable evidence, not a measured failure.

subject_commit.description: Host-derived raw commit OID. Dispatch-owned: a worker-authored value is stripped before the canonical report; only the core work-context subject supplies it.

recipe_source.description: The exact pinned harness identity a receipt executed: a repository file at an exact commit. A receipt names the recipe the control pinned, never the candidate's modified copy of the harness.

exit_code.description: Required exactly when result is pass or fail: the control's exit status.

run_ref.description: The immutable native-run or artifact locator of the execution. Nonempty exactly when result is pass or fail; a not_run or unavailable result carries the empty string and names its explanation in evidence_refs. Never invent a locator: when no producing route issued one, result is unavailable and run_ref stays empty.

lane_worker_oracle_finding.description: The typed oracle tie of one review finding (CON-890), mirroring contracts/agent-lane-report.schema.json $defs/oracle_finding exactly: a closed classification plus the owner, predicate/law, case, and control references that bind it. Classification and severity are different dimensions; the tie records no acceptance.

classification.description: delivery_blocker: a failed obligation of a declared owner. uncovered_case: a legitimate new entry path the inventory omitted — a real blocker, not a rejection. follow_up: outside the approved owner/contract; never an open repair criterion. oracle_defect: the harness itself is obsolete, inconsistent, or unsound; it blocks readiness, not a fabricated repair.

evidence_refs.description: The reproducible evidence that supports the finding. A known control failure names that control's receipt.

entry_point.description: For an uncovered_case: the explicit new entry path or transition the inventory omitted.

continues_finding_id.description: The earlier ranked finding of this work that this finding continues. Same failure, same canonical open identity; an uncertain join becomes a new finding and earns no shrink credit.

variant_of.description: The owner-family finding this newly reproduced alternate entry path is a variant of. A variant is a new identity, not the same open finding.

lane_native_oracle_stream.description: Native producer descriptor only. One raw BLOB per stream stays on the existing verify lease. A complete ref requires atomic full capture; incomplete and abandoned output cannot supply full-output acceptance. Preview truncation does not imply stream truncation.

selected_test_names.description: The nominal maximum derives from floor((256-13)/6), not an independent test allowance. Every rendered selector still obeys sum(name bytes)+N+13 <= 256. No truncation or omitted witness.

lane_native_oracle_preparation.description: The store-selected qualified preparation for an immutable job's exact readiness reference, never a latest-run guess or worker assertion. Pure-Go top-level tests only. The native owner proves exact pinned file bytes, cwd, build-selected nonempty witnesses, and compile-only readiness. Non-Go and resolved embed inputs must be declared pinned fixtures or explicit compiler inputs; no production Go/module replacement. Every stage pins the installed toolchain and native target with GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOPROXY=off, GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly, CGO_ENABLED=0, GOWORK=off, and a private disposable GOCACHE. No aggregate scratch quota or uncommitted-diagnostics promise. Preparation grants no worker attempt, verification authority, or semantic acceptance.

lane_work_context_view.description: The core reader's current work-context view (CON-887), carried verbatim from the work pin. Every bound mirrors internal/store WorkContextView exactly.

source_event_frontier.description: The highest sequence among the work item's context-source events (declarations and terminal worker reports) the view was assembled at.

oracle_receipts.description: The prior typed control-execution receipts this work retained (CON-890), in log order: reported regression baselines with their exact identities, never current-subject acceptance.

oracle_preparations.description: Only native preparation records selected by the immutable job's readiness refs. No raw output or alternative readiness authority.

subject_commit.description: The sole core-derived current subject, as a raw commit OID. Native receipt subject_ref remains commit:OID and the store normalizes that reference once.

path.description: A normalized relative repository-contained path at the pinned commit; read the pinned Git bytes, not the changed checkout.

finding_id.description: Core-derived from the source event sequence and ordinal; never authored.

kind.description: The generic claim vocabulary of an authored finding. A ranked oracle finding projects the empty kind (CON-890): its identity is the oracle tie, never a generic claim class.

evidence_refs.description: The evidence that supports the finding. A ranked finding without an oracle tie projects null; the core reader owns that wire shape.

status.description: A finding is a reported claim, never acceptance. The open status names a ranked review finding the lineage currently holds open (CON-890): still a claim, and open.

source_kind.description: Present only on a ranked review finding (CON-890): the entry carries an oracle tie and rides the open-set lineage, never the generic worker-claim notebook.

oracle.description: The typed oracle tie of a ranked review finding (CON-890): classification plus the owner, predicate/law, case, and control references that bind it.

domain_cards.description: Pinned repository_file references derived by the shared reader. The group supplies the validated Domain identity. Cards also occupy the existing required_reading bound; content is never inlined.

lane_context_checkpoint.description: The owning continuity reader's latest context checkpoint (CON-883), carried verbatim from the pinned continuity projection. Every bound mirrors internal/store ContextCheckpoint exactly; the projection carries no source event identity, so checkpoint_id, work_version, and sequence are the durable identity.

strategy.description: Coordinator direction the worker follows for this attempt.

items.description: A workflow reference list item: whitespace-free, 2-128 chars, matching the store's ValidReference. Slashes are allowed because touched refs name repository paths.
A workflow reference list item: whitespace-free, 2-128 chars, matching the store's ValidReference.

lane_law_context.description: The approved contract's binding law and Domains, resolved at continuity read time from the law_subjects and domains projections. Absent when the contract binds no law and no Domain.

registry_path.description: The repository path of the Domain registry shard. Present when the context binds at least one Domain, so a dispatched lane reads Domain structure from the file instead of a Concord tool.

roles.description: Every binding role the approved contract gives the law, sorted and deduplicated.

obligation_ids.description: The contract's verification obligations that name the law, sorted and deduplicated. Present only when roles carries obligation.

kind.description: The law_subjects record kind. Constitution records are law-bearing and project into law_subjects, so a contract can mandate them.

criteria.description: The law's acceptance criteria bound to the reading work item's own outcome predicates (CD-0180). Present only when at least one criterion binds this work item.

lane_proposal_record.description: The recorded proposal fields the dispatched lane packet renders. Absent when no proposal is recorded.

lane_work_record.description: The work item's recorded value statement, task, and narrative, each verbatim and present exactly when the recorded text is not blank. The core refuses a dispatch whose packet member differs from the recorded work item.
